text.p: Intermagnetics General Corp said on Friday that it had signed a tentative deal to acquire a leading maker of accessories used in MRI medical imaging systems.
The undisclosed, privately-held company is expected to add several million dollars of profitable sales as well as expand Intermagnetics' product lines, the company said.

Intermagnetics said in a separate statement that it had agreed with Philips Medical Systems to extend the long-term MRI magnet supply agreement through December 2000. The companies entered the agreement in 1996, Intermagnetics said.
Intermagnetics's sales of MRI magnet products grew from approximately $19 Million in fiscal 1993 to over $40 Million in fiscal 1996, the company said.

InterCool Energy, an Intermagnetics subsidiary, said it has also entered an agreement with AlliedSignal Inc for AlliedSignal to make its FRIGC FR-12 refrigerant for Intercool distribution into the North American mobile air conditioning market.
FRIGC FR-12 is an alternative to using Freon in air conditioning systems.
